scenario: 500 Sybils behind 50 attack edges (50 distinct honest users -> 50 distinct gateway Sybils), internal ER p=0.05, SNAP Facebook honest graph, 5 injections (seeds 0-4), stratified 70/10/20
classifier: BotGATv2Skip on structural features, 600 epochs, best val loss (same as dense/sparse v2)
primary_method: naaf_gated_hard with tau = 0.995 quantile of P(bot) over val humans (q fixed from the MGTAB choice; not tuned here)
evasion: fraction f in {0, .25, .5, .75, 1} of Sybil voters take the score of a random honest user; nested evader sets
claim: for every f, NAAF accepts <= the Sybil votes of BOTH SumUp and classifier-only (mean over 5 injections)
also_reported: honest collection rate for every method; NAAF-A; val and test both reported because nothing is tuned on val
